Get P. LEAGUE+ Preciser Rotation

Source: R/pleague.R
pleague_preciser_rotation.Rd

On-court stints of every player of one finished game (the rotation chart).

Endpoint: GET https://api.preciser.io/game/rotation/chart/o/plg/gameId/{uuid}

Usage

pleague_preciser_rotation(uuid, gid = NULL)

Arguments

uuid

Required. The Preciser game uuid the site's game page embeds (uuid of pleague_game; empty before 2022-23, which have no vendor data), e.g. 'e6f98675-3e5b-11ed-949e-5d17350689cf' (gid 197).

gid

Optional. The site's game id for this uuid. When given the runtime also fetches the site's game page and box (cached) and checks the vendor body against them (uuid, final score, made shots, roster and minutes); the uuid must be the game page's. Without it only the checks the body allows by itself run.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: On-court stints of every player of one finished game (the rotation chart). An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sdv-py pleague_preciser_rotation):

col_nametypedescription
game_uuidcharacterPreciser game uuid (key space: the vendor's games, a version-1 uuid), the uuid asked for; uuid of pleague_game.
sidecharacterWhich team the row belongs to: home or away.
name_zhcharacterPlayer name (Traditional Chinese); equals the site box name_zh, which is how the runtime checks the roster.
jerseyintegerShirt number (an integer here; the box prints it as a string).
startedlogicalTrue when the player started the game.
stint_nointeger1-based position of the stint among the player's stints, in game order.
start_periodcharacterPeriod in which the stint starts (Q1-Q4, OT1, ...).
start_clockcharacterClock REMAINING in start_period when the stint starts, 'm:ss'.
start_secondsintegerSeconds elapsed on the game clock when the stint starts (cumulative across periods).
end_periodcharacterPeriod in which the stint ends.
end_clockcharacterClock REMAINING in end_period when the stint ends, 'm:ss'.
end_secondsintegerSeconds elapsed on the game clock when the stint ends (cumulative across periods).

Details

  • Unofficial use of a THIRD-PARTY host: api.preciser.io is the analytics vendor behind the P. LEAGUE+ game page, not the league's own API. It is keyless, CORS-open, has no robots.txt (404) and no terms were found; it serves the data the league's own game page displays. The league's /user-policy reserves its content, so payloads are not redistributed as release assets and a data release needs owner sign-off. Requests are spaced at least 1 s apart per host, retries included.

  • Wrappers take the Preciser game uuid (the uuid column of pleague_game(); empty before 2022-23, which have no vendor data). Pass the optional gid to verify the body against the site's game page and box: the shot list and the rotation echo nothing about the game, so only then are the uuid, the final score, the made-shot counts, the roster and the court time (rotation minutes within 30 s of the box) checked. An unknown uuid answers 200 [] (hoopR_no_data) or HTTP 500 (hoopR_asset_fetch, not retried).

  • Id key spaces: the vendor names teams by uuid (team_uuid / home_team_uuid / away_team_uuid) and persons by person_id (the same value as the site box row's person_id); the site's team_id (1-8) joins to a team uuid through pleague_team_crosswalk() (the standings logo file name).

  • Shot x / y are in the VENDOR frame (percent of the court, the home team always attacks x = 95) while the site's play-by-play x / y are in the physical court frame (teams swap ends at half-time): x_vendor = 100 - x_pbp and y_vendor = 100 - y_pbp in the halves where the home team attacks x < 50. The court is 28.75 x 15.25 m. Clip urls carry a vendor access key (?key=): it is scrubbed from every body, a body that still holds one is refused, and no frame keeps a url.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a body of [], empty rotation lists), hoopR_bad_request (a uuid that is not a uuid, a gid that is not an integer, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failed or wrong answer, including a gid whose game has another uuid and a redirect off the vendor host). HTTP 429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried, up to three attempts.

See also

Other P. LEAGUE+ Functions: pleague_box_players(), pleague_box_teams(), pleague_game(), pleague_officials(), pleague_pbp(), pleague_periods(), pleague_player(), pleague_player_seasons(), pleague_preciser_injury(), pleague_preciser_lead_flow(), pleague_preciser_score_log(), pleague_preciser_shots(), pleague_preciser_summary_teams(), pleague_preciser_win_probability(), pleague_schedule(), pleague_standings(), pleague_stat_player(), pleague_team_crosswalk()
